name: GL_RECONCILIATION_RULES
description: This table contains the reconciliation types that represent reconcilable clearing accounts and the associated rules  that are applied to match and reconcile those clearing accounts.

columns.name: RECON_RULE_ID
columns.description: Reconciliation rule unique sequence-generated identifier.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Chart of accounts identifier for accounting key flexfield structure instance number for which this setup applies.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for which this setup applies.

columns.name: RECON_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Reconciliation rule unique name.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the reconciliation rule.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percentage by which the amount is allowed to be different when performing manual reconciliation.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum difference in amount that is allowed when performing manual reconciliation.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Earliest accounting date from which the journal lines will be considered for performing reconciliation.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this reconciliation definition is active.

columns.name: AUTO_RECON_RUN_DATE
columns.description: Latest date on which the automatic reconciliation program was successfully run for this reconciliation rule.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_MATCHING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Account segments to be used to match and group journal lines when performing reconciliation.

columns.name: FLEX_FILTER
columns.description: Accounting key flexfield criteria used to select clearing accounts for reconciliation.
